description: This PHP file defines the class `LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportData` within the namespace `OrangeHRM\Leaveeport`. The class implements report data processing for leave entitlement usage, handling data normalization, and report meta information, specific to leave types for employees. It utilizes multiple traits for services like leave entitlements, leave types, employees, date/time helper, normalization, number formatting, and internationalization. Key methods include `normalize()` for assembling report data and `getMeta()` for report metadata.

classes.name: LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportData

methods.description: Generates a normalized array of employee leave entitlement usage data based on filter parameters.
